items.name: Roasted pork loin slices (or turkey breast), seasoned
Breaded/seasoned fried fish fillet (or chicken) with sauteed red onion
items.preparation: coated and pan-fried, topped with a little sauteed onion

items.name: Cooking oil absorbed in fried item
items.preparation: frying oil implied by browned coating

scale_cues: White square dinner plate assumed about 26 cm across; melon cubes assumed about 2.5-3 cm per side; meat slices sized relative to the plate.
assumptions: Pale sliced meat is lean roasted pork loin; turkey breast would give similar calories and protein
Browned coated piece is a pan-fried breaded fish or chicken fillet with moderate oil absorption
Green cubes are honeydew melon, not cooked squash or cucumber
Small reddish-brown bits are bacon bits or fried crumbs
No hidden sauces or extra butter beyond what is visible
